response.overview: When a family-run café faces imminent closure in the run-up to Christmas, its owner, Elle, and her daughter face losing their cherished home to greedy developers. However, hope arrives in the form of a magic wish-granting chair that intertwines their lives with suave entrepreneur, William, who has just arrived in town on vacation. As romance blossoms between Elle and William, can they unite the community and save the Mountain View? This heartwarming festive romance stars Golden Globe winner Jeremy Piven (Entourage, Mr Selfridge) and Emmy nominee Elizabeth Mitchell (Lost, The Santa Clauses).
response.title: A Christmas Wish for Everyone
